name: Station sequence (one layer per station, cross-faded)
purpose: A film told as consecutive stations (exercises, steps, chapters): each station gets its own layer, is visible only in its own window and cross-fades into the next at the boundary, so a builder per station adds tweens inside a known window instead of hand-coding show/hide for every scene.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.description: One or more hosts; each station gets a layer in every host (a <g> in an SVG host, a div otherwise), so a picture and its copy fade together

inputs.name: stations
inputs.description: [{id, start, end, build(layers, win, tl)}]; win = {index, start, end, in, out}, in/out being when the station is fully visible

inputs.name: fade
inputs.description: Cross-fade length where one station ends as the next starts; a gap between stations is a hard hide/show

inputs.name: hold
inputs.description: Keep the last station to the end of the film

implementation.api: Studio.comp.stations(parent, stations, {fade, hold, className}) -> {layers, windows, schedule(tl) -> end time}

layout_notes: Layers fill their host (.st-station, inset 0); layout inside a layer is the builder's. Format-neutral.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (windows, zero-dip cross-fade, gap, hold:false)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
